title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Returns and Registry Credit Schedule
content:
**Returns and registry credit schedule of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry.** A registrant may return gifts guests bought from the registry within a registry return window counted from the event date; the value of such a return is held on the registry as registry credit.

### Registry return window by type

| Registry type | Registry gift return window, calendar days after the event date |
|---|---|
| Celebration Registry | 60 |
| Graduation Registry | 60 |
| Housewarming Registry | 90 |
| Baby Registry | 180 |
| Anniversary Registry | 90 |
| Wedding Registry | 180 |

### Terms identical for every registry type

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Deadline for a registry gift return | the later of the registry return window and the ordinary return window of the gift's merchandise class |
| Amount credited for a returned registry gift | the net price the guest paid for it |
| Proof the registrant needs | the registry gift record (no receipt) |
| Exchange for another item instead of credit | allowed |
| What registry credit can be spent on | any Marlowe & Finch merchandise purchase |
| What remaining registry credit becomes when the registry closes or is cancelled | a merchandise credit card |
| Time for that conversion | within 30 calendar days after the registry closes or is cancelled |

### Notes

- The registry window and the class window are compared and the later deadline governs; neither is added to the other.
- *Illustration (hypothetical):* a gift on an Anniversary Registry whose event date was 1 June has a registry window running 90 calendar days after 1 June; if the ordinary class deadline of that gift happened to fall later, the later date would be its deadline.
